retry.policy: Safe to retry. The purge is accept-then-poll: the first call records it in progress and hands the shard walk to a background timer, then waits a bounded time; a call while the purge runs, or after it completed, returns the current status without error, so after an ambiguous failure or a return with PurgeInProgress still true, read the deletion status or simply call again.

idempotency.basis: Accepting a purge that is already running or complete changes nothing and returns its status; the background walk resumes from its last durably recorded shard after a restart.

error_taxonomy.meaning: Cluster state or reserved-target invariants refused a well-formed request.
Unhandled facade or binding failure after logging.
The tenant or grant is absent, or a facade deliberately unifies unauthorized visibility with absence.
The transport authorizer, access gate, or active-tenant validation denied the caller.

The active tenant quota, or a delegated tenant access cap (MaxGroups, MaxMembershipEdges, MaxMemberSubjects, MaxTenantRules), would be exceeded. Over gRPC it is ResourceExhausted with lattice-quota-dimension, -current and -limit trailers. A delegated access cap addition found over the cap is withdrawn with up to four attempts; if none lands, the message says the cap may stay exceeded until the addition is removed.
No active tenant is in scope; the tenant-scoped facade refuses the call before any tree is named.
